Args.headline: Claude Code IDE chat session list indicator: ... means BUSY/WORKING, not interrupted
Args.context: Tim 觀察 IDE 左側 chat session list 顯示 basecamp ● Gura ○ meadow ... 誤以為 ... 代表中斷, 進而判斷 marathon/waiter 模式無法跑. 實際是: ● = focused, ○ = idle (no tool running), ... = working/busy/loop active. meadow 18 cycles 證明 waiter 正常跑.
Args.lesson: 判斷 agent loop 是否中斷不能只看 IDE 側欄 indicator. Single source of truth 應該看 waiter_sessions.json (cycles 數會 increment) + audit jsonl tail. ... 是 active 信號不是 fail 信號.
